## Shared scenes

> Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) notices [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) dressed in his best clothes driving out of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and goes to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to investigate. [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) explains that [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) has gone to [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) to pick up an orphan boy from [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) to help on the farm. Mrs. Rachel warns [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) of the dangers of adopting an unknown child before taking her leave.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised
